title: Belief-Based Maximum Occupancy Principle and Active Inference
abstract: arXiv:2609.39342v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Intrinsic motivation plays a central role in adaptive and goal-directed behavior by conferring agents reward-independent objectives and biases useful to act in noisy and uncertain environments. Active Inference addresses the problem of acting in a partially observable environment through a principled framework for belief updating and action selection. A key component of Active Inference is the specification of prior preferences, which shapes behavior by encoding desirable future outcomes. An intrinsic motivation approach called the Maximum Occupancy Principle (MOP) proposes that agents act so as to maximize occupancy over future paths of states and actions, with no preferences or epistemic targets. Despite its simple formulation, MOP gives rise to rich and adaptive behaviors that combine exploratory variability with goal-directed dynamics. In this work, we extend MOP to partially observable environments and introduce a Bellman reformul

translated_title: 基于信念的最大占据原理与主动推断
translated_abstract: 内在动机在适应性和目标导向行为中发挥着核心作用，它为智能体提供独立于奖励的目标和偏向，有助于其在嘈杂且不确定的环境中行动。主动推断通过一个有原则的信念更新与动作选择框架，解决了在部分可观测环境中行动的问题。主动推断的一个关键组成部分是先验偏好的设定，它通过编码期望的未来结果来塑造行为。一种被称为最大占据原理的内在动机方法提出，智能体的行动应当最大化未来状态和动作路径的占据度，而无需任何偏好或认知目标。尽管其表述简单，MOP 却能产生将探索性变异性与目标导向动态相结合的丰富且自适应的行为。在这项工作中，我们将 MOP 扩展到部分可观测的环境，并引入了一种 Bellman 重构（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文将无偏好、无认知目标的最大占据原理扩展到部分可观测环境，并在主动推断框架下引入 Bellman 重构，从而在保持简单形式的同时产生兼具探索性与目标导向性的自适应行为。
en_tdlr: This work extends the preference-free Maximum Occupancy Principle (MOP) to partially observable environments within the Active Inference framework, introducing a Bellman reformulation that yields rich, adaptive behavior combining exploratory variability with goal-directed dynamics.
